case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel’s breakfast, cleanliness, peaceful natural setting, and friendly, attentive staff, noting comfortable, spacious rooms and beds. Positive comments also mentioned helpful reception and thoughtful gestures. Negative remarks were isolated and included a problematic shower, refrigerator noise in a room, an unheated indoor pool, and the property’s distance from town (several reviewers noted a car is essential).
